_comment-platforms: Where each platform ships. A leg's object holds only what differs from the product: scheme, bundle-id, configuration, product-name; the direct leg also takes the S3/Sparkle settings, an app-store or ad-hoc leg "distribute": false to build without uploading. Delete the legs you don't ship. No profiles anywhere: CI downloads them from App Store Connect and signs every extension with the profile for its bundle ID.
